lead.description: factors that convert the prior odds of a condition into posterior odds after a test result

overview_sentence: A diagnostic likelihood ratio multiplies the prior odds of a condition after a test result.

self_checks.title: Mammogram ratio
self_checks.prompt: Sensitivity 0.89 and false-positive rate 0.07. What is the positive likelihood ratio?

self_checks.title: Posterior probability
self_checks.prompt: Prior odds about 0.003512 times a likelihood ratio of about 12.714. What is the posterior probability?

self_checks.title: A simpler test
self_checks.prompt: Sensitivity 0.80, false-positive rate 0.10, base rate 0.20. What are the posterior odds and the posterior probability?
self_checks.answer: The posterior odds are 2 and the posterior probability is 2/3.
